title: Wire Fee on Seller Closing Contributions (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction)
content:
Wire receipt charges — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

Contribution wire fee: on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, part of the seller closing contribution. The contribution wire fee is USD 30.00 when the case carries three or more payoff funds receipts sent by wire, recalled ones included, and USD 15.00 when it carries exactly two; a case with fewer carries no wire fee (0.00).

*Hypothetical:* a case with one wire from an heir and one cashier's check carries no wire fee; a case with two wires, one of them recalled, carries USD 15.00; a case with three wires carries USD 30.00.
